overview: Guide Shop is a French mobile-first VIP task and commission platform where members complete daily product tasks, earn commissions, request recharges and withdrawals, and chat with customer service, all managed by an admin console.
features: Phone and password sign-in with promo-code signup
Five tabs: Accueil, Enregistrements, Démarrage, Service, Compte
Daily task flow with VIP levels, quotas and commissions
Admin-controlled recharge requests and manual crediting
Withdrawals with secondary password and 2000 FCFA minimum
Customer service chat with photo, video and file attachments
Admin console for accounts, withdrawals, VIP settings, tasks and inbox
